description: The 12-digit hydrologic unit each 0.1 degree cell's centre lies in, from the USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset. Used only to read USGS GAP range tables (which list sub-watersheds) onto the land-cover grid; never drawn and never a hunting boundary.

grid.layout: row, column; little-endian uint32, 0 = none, else 1 + index into hucs

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD), HU2 regions 01-18 (the conterminous United States), shapefile, layer WBDHU12
source.licence: Public domain (work of the United States Government)
source.crs: NAD83 geographic, used as published (within about a metre of WGS 84)
